_comment: Syllabus fixtures in the formats students actually upload: markdown
headings, numbered outlines, and 'Unit I / Unit II' university style.
Every case includes noise the parser must NOT promote into topics --
page footers, 'Prescribed Textbooks' sections, exam-pattern boilerplate.
That is exactly the bug that shipped once: page headers became topics and
the roadmap filled with entries like 'Page 4 of 12'. Recall alone cannot
catch it, which is why precision is scored too.
